title: postauthregister
description: Verify that registering a new club with valid name, email, and password returns 201 with message, club_id, and email, and that registering with an already-registered email returns 400 with appropriate error message.

title: postauthlogin
description: Verify that logging in with valid credentials returns 200 with access_token and token_type, and logging in with invalid credentials returns 401 with invalid credentials message.

title: deletemedeleteaccount
description: Verify that deleting the current club account with valid authorization returns 200 with confirmation message, and without authorization returns 401 unauthorized.

title: postplayers
description: Verify that creating a new player with valid name and phone under authorized club returns 200 with player data, and creating a player with invalid (empty after trimming) name returns 400 validation error.

title: getsessionsactive
description: Verify that fetching the active open session with valid authorization returns 200 with session data or null if none active.

title: postsessionssessionidclose
description: Verify that closing a session with matching declared rake and jackpot cash returns 200 with close result, and closing with mismatched declared totals returns 409 mismatch error.

title: posttransactions
description: Verify that creating a transaction with valid player_id, session_id, amount > 0, and method returns 200 with transaction data, and creating with amount 0 returns 400 validation error.

title: posttournaments
description: Verify that creating a tournament with valid name, buyin_amount, rake_percentage, and payout_structure returns 200 with tournament data, and creating when another active tournament exists returns 409 conflict.

title: getstatsdashboard
description: Verify that fetching dashboard KPIs with valid authorization returns 200 with dashboard stats, and with invalid or expired token returns 401 unauthorized.

title: postconfiginitialsetup
description: Verify that posting initial setup with monthly_goal and partners list with valid authorization returns 200 with confirmation message.
